description: Thirty-five manually labeled synthetic answer-validation cases with distinct questions and passages; 17 calibration and 18 held-out validation cases.
limitations: Claims and verifier outputs are curated fixtures, not Gemini generations.
The same behavior categories appear in both splits, but calibration and validation use distinct questions and passages.
A semantically wrong but syntactically valid citation case shows that backend reference validation cannot prove support when the model verifier is wrong.
Scores measure deterministic validator behavior on a small synthetic dataset, not live model quality or production accuracy.
Passage support, correctness, and relevance labels are manually authored.
The calibration split is reported separately; this evaluator does not tune runtime parameters.

metric_formulas.citation_precision: Supported returned citations / all returned citations.
metric_formulas.citation_coverage: Gold factual claims returned with a labeled supporting citation / gold factual claims expected to be returned.
metric_formulas.claim_faithfulness: Returned claims with a labeled supporting citation / all returned claims.
metric_formulas.unsupported_claim_rate: Returned claims without a labeled supporting citation / all returned claims.
metric_formulas.contradiction_detection: Case-level precision and recall against gold conflict labels.
metric_formulas.evidence_sufficiency: Case-level precision and recall against gold evidence_sufficient labels.
metric_formulas.document_only_answer_mode_accuracy: Predicted response mode matches the gold response mode.
metric_formulas.returned_claim_correctness_relevance: Fraction of returned claims manually labeled correct/relevant; correctness also requires at least one labeled supporting citation. This is claim-level, not whole-answer semantic scoring.
